caption: Physical Report Activity
description: Physical Report Activity events report the lifecycle of a report written by security personnel about an incident or condition observed at a site. The report is the initiating record created by the reporting organization, not an analytical finding. Classification follows the dual-coding pattern established by the Emergency Incident Data Document: a required common type from the incident_type_id enum, alongside the reporting organization's own internal type. Optional crosswalk attributes carry the equivalent public safety and offense codes where the incident maps to them.
name: physical_report_activity

3.caption: Submitted
3.description: The report was submitted for review.

7.caption: Referred
